archetypes.name: dyn-ledger-history
archetypes.rationale: The change extends append-only ledger metadata and historical hydration across compute and report phases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect coordinator metadata upserts, analytics corpus canonicalization, and deferred historical hydration. Check that legacy rows remain compatible, repeated rows cannot inflate aggregates, and report failures cannot mutate durable history. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
